signatures.why: Windows, cards, buttons, HUD tiles, pills and the close button all carry a dark navy outline. This is the strongest part of the kit and well ahead of X3, X4 and KITpass9.

The white window body has a clean rim, but card faces barely show a light inner line. On the XP bar the highlight runs past the fill (1050,113), so it reads as a stray line, not a rim. Compare P05, where every surface has one.
Buttons have solid darker lips and the press shots show the face sinking onto them. The card faces carry a mild vertical gradient with a sunburst.
Studs stay at low opacity on headers and cards, far below KITpass9's 70%. They still get loud in the empty hotbar slots and inside the '+' buttons.

signatures.signature: 5. white text with navy strokes and real currency glyphs
signatures.why: The Robux hexagon glyph and gem and coin icons are used correctly. The navy stroke is only about 2px, though, against the 4-6px chunky strokes in P07-P09, so titles and labels look thin and small.

signatures.signature: 6. one consistent human-made icon family, big
signatures.why: There are two families. Untextured low-poly 3D renders (cart, cat, coin, gem, gift, chest, eggs) sit beside flat white 2D glyphs in Settings (music note, speaker, gear). The renders look procedural: the coin reads as a hex nut, the eggs are one shape in different tints, and the cart and cat are grey. Nothing comes near the glossy illustrated icons in P07-P09.

signatures.signature: 7. one hero and a clean, full grid
signatures.why: E1 and E2 have a wide hero, three cards and a double-width last card with no orphans. E4 makes Day 7 the wide finale and E3 is a full 4x2 grid. Weakest point: E3 and E6 have no focal item.

Between play0 and play1 the only changes are the sunburst rotating a few degrees and the item icons bobbing slightly. The CTA, the NEW tag and the Starter Pack tile do not move. Hover at scale 1.05 cannot be told apart from play0 on any screen; only the press sink can be seen.

defects.defect: The open window covers the hotbar. Slots 1-6 are cut off at y~980 and only the bottoms of 'Sword', 'Pickaxe' and 'Potion' show under the window edge, so it looks like a layout collision on every window screen.
defects.fix: Hide or slide the hotbar out while a window is open, or end the window at y<=940 so the gap is clean.

defects.defect: All six eggs (510,700), (860,700), (1205,700), (515,860), (925,860) and the hero (575,495) are the same faceted low-poly egg in pastel tints. This repeats anti-reference X4 defect 4: no craft per item and nothing tells the player which egg is best.
defects.fix: Give each egg its own art (spots, leaf wrap, crystal shards, lava cracks, gold shine, void stars), fully saturated with a specular highlight. Make the most valuable egg the hero.

defects.defect: The hero 'Void Egg' is a washed-out lilac egg on a purple card, so contrast is close to zero and it doesn't read as rare or as void. The header egg (480,240) is a different pale cream egg, so the window has two egg identities.
defects.fix: Make it a near-black violet egg with magenta glow, star specks and a rim light, and use the same egg as the header icon.

defects.defect: The Settings icons (music 495,440, speaker 495,645, gear 495,850) are flat white 2D glyphs, while every other screen uses 3D renders. The Graphics row also reuses the window's own gear icon (480,240), so the icon set is visibly split.
defects.fix: Render music, speaker and graphics icons in the same 3D cartoon style with navy contours. Use a monitor or sparkle icon for Graphics.

defects.defect: The coin icon is an octagon with a recessed octagonal hole and reads as a hex nut, not a coin. The same art is used at (860,700) in E1 and on Day 1 and Day 4 in E4.
defects.fix: Use a round, thick gold coin with an embossed star or emblem, a bright rim bevel and one white specular highlight.

defects.defect: The Shop icon is a grey metal cart, both in the header and on the HUD tile (85,325), and the Pets icon is a grey cat (85,520). Desaturated grey on pink and yellow reads as placeholder; P07's basket is saturated red and full of goods.
defects.fix: Recolour the cart as a red or pink basket with items in it. Make the Pets icon a bright, colourful pet. No grey hero icons.

defects.defect: The window title 'Shop' has about 40px caps in a ~140px header and sits 60px right of the icon, leaving most of the header as empty stud wallpaper. In P07 and P10 the title is huge and breaks out of the frame.
defects.fix: Set titles to 72-84px with a 5-6px navy stroke, tuck them against the icon, and shrink the header to about 100px.

defects.defect: Text strokes are thin (about 2px) everywhere: 'Starter Pack', card names, '500 gems, 2x luck' and HUD labels. Next to P07-P09 the text looks light and spindly.
defects.fix: Use UIStroke thickness 3-4 at 1080p in navy, plus a 2px navy drop offset under the headline text.

defects.defect: The rarity labels ('Legendary', 'Epic', 'Rare' and so on) are about 18px and sit directly on the button tops at (552,563) and (1368,868), with no gap and too small to scan. Pet art also runs into the names: the Bunny's ears at (1096,705) and the Panda's head at (825,405).
defects.fix: Show rarity as a coloured ribbon or pill at the card's top corner. Reserve fixed vertical slots for name, art and button with 8-12px gaps.

defects.defect: The buttons on locked days just repeat the card title ('Day 4', 'Day 5', 'Day 6', 'Day 7'). The Day 7 grand prize gets the largest and dullest flat grey button, and the claimed days have no checkmark (552,490).
defects.fix: Locked days get a lock icon and a countdown ('in 1d'). Claimed days get a green check stamp with the icon dimmed. Give Day 7 a gold glow, a pulse and a crown or ribbon.

defects.defect: The Music and Sound Effects sliders (1240,442) and (1240,645) have no knob and no value label, so they read as progress bars, not controls.
defects.fix: Add a round white knob with a navy contour and lip at the fill end, and a '70%' label.

defects.defect: The 'Level 7  640 / 1,000 XP' text straddles the fill edge, half on green and half on navy, and has a double space. The pale highlight line overshoots the fill's rounded end at (1050,113). The bar has no level badge.
defects.fix: Put a round level badge at the left end, centre a single label with a thick stroke, and clip the highlight to the fill.

defects.defect: The hover state can't be seen. In every -hover shot the first button is pixel-identical in size and colour to play0, so the 1.05 scale is either not applied or too small to notice.
defects.fix: Hover at scale 1.08-1.1 with a brightness lift and a slight rotation, tweened over 0.08s with Back easing. Check by diffing the button's bounding box.

defects.defect: Motion is close to absent. Between play0 and play1 only the sunburst rotates and the icons bob a little. The hero CTA (1285,492), the 'NEW!' tag (790,365) and the Starter Pack tile (1810,330) are fully static.
defects.fix: Pulse the CTA at 1.0-1.04 on a 1.2s loop, sweep a diagonal shine across it every 3s, wobble the NEW tag ±4°, and bounce the Starter Pack gift.

defects.defect: The currency pill bodies are flat light grey (200,885) and (200,1002), dull next to the bright tiles. The '+' glyph is about 15px inside a 60px button (338,885), and the gem icon spills below the pill (90,1040).
defects.fix: Use a white body with a pale inner rim or a navy translucent pill, double the '+' glyph, and keep icons inside the pill's vertical bounds.

defects.defect: The price buttons in the small cards sit flush on the card's bottom edge, so their lip merges into the card contour ((672,765), (1018,765), (1364,765)) and nothing frames them.
defects.fix: Add 10-12px bottom padding inside each card so the button lip clears the contour.

defects.defect: The Forest Egg price button is orange while every other egg price is green, which reads as a different state. On the Golden Egg the gem glyph (1125,905) sits ~175px from its number (1300,905).
defects.fix: Use one CTA colour for every price (change the card tint if it clashes), and centre glyph and number as one group.

defects.defect: Every window is the same ~1160x800 box, so Settings stretches three rows into huge empty blue slabs with the labels lost on the left.
defects.fix: Size windows to their content (Settings about 800x560) and use rows about 110px tall.

defects.defect: The empty hotbar slots show studs more strongly than any other surface, and no slot is marked as selected.
defects.fix: Lower the stud opacity in empty slots to match the cards, and give the active slot a gold contour with a lift.

critics.verdict: Structurally the kit is now competent. It has a navy contour everywhere, a white window body, solid lips with a working press sink, faint studs, a real Robux glyph and a hero with a clean, full grid. It would no longer be mistaken for X3, X4 or KITpass9. It still could not sit next to P07-P09, for three reasons: the art is programmer art, the type is weak, and nothing moves. The three changes that would raise the score most: (1) Replace the whole icon set with one illustrated, saturated, glossy family: a real coin, not a hex nut; a coloured basket, not a grey cart; distinct eggs with patterns instead of one faceted shape in pastel tints; and 3D Settings icons instead of flat glyphs. Icons carry about half the perceived quality in the anchors, and this alone is worth +1.5. (2) Rework the type: titles at 72-84px tucked against the header icon, every stroke at 3-4px navy with a drop offset, rarity as ribbons, an XP bar with a level badge, and windows sized to their content. (3) Make motion visible and make the layout respect the HUD: a 1.08+ hover with a brightness lift, a pulsing CTA with a shine sweep, a wobbling NEW tag, and the hotbar hidden or cleared while a window is open so the window stops covering it. With those three this is a 7.5-8. As it stands it is a clean 6.

signatures.why: Windows, cards, buttons, pills, close button and text all carry a dark navy contour. The gap is the icon renders themselves (cart, cat, eggs, chest), which have no outline, unlike P08 and P09.
A thin 1-2px pale line shows on the HUD tiles and some card tops. It nearly vanishes on the yellow, teal and gray cards and on the window's white body. P05 has a clearly readable light rim.
Price, Equip and Claim buttons, cards and HUD tiles have a vertical gradient face over a darker solid lip, and the recipe is applied consistently.
Studs are at low opacity on headers and cards, well below the full-strength stud wallpaper of KITpass9. They are slightly loud on the yellow Daily header and on the gray Claimed cards.

signatures.signature: 5. white text with navy strokes and real currency glyphs
signatures.why: All labels are white with a navy stroke. Robux prices use the real glyph and gem prices use a gem icon, so no 'R$' or 'Gems 100' text remains.

signatures.signature: 6. one consistent human-made icon family, big
signatures.why: Shop, pets and daily share a low-poly 3D render style, but Settings switches to flat white 2D glyphs. Eggs are one pastel blob in six tints, the coin reads as a hex nut, gem, cart and cat are desaturated or gray, and icons fill only about 30% of their cards.

signatures.signature: 7. one hero and a clean, full grid
signatures.why: E1 and E2 have a full-width hero, a 3-card row and a 1+wide row with no orphans. E3 is a full 2x4 grid. E4's grid is full, but the 'Today' card is no bigger than the others, so its emphasis is weak.

Between play0 and play1 only the sunburst rays rotate about 15 degrees and icons bob a few px. Hover at 1.05 shows no visible change, and press re-flows the whole HUD column. There is no shine sweep, pulse or badge wobble.

defects.defect: Pressing the Shop HUD tile changes all three left-column tiles: Shop, Pets (83,520) and Settings (83,715) all lose their lips and move up about 5px. The face also rises rather than sinking (the Shop label moves from y 387 to 382). The same happens in E2-E6 press.
defects.fix: Apply the press only to the pressed button. Keep the button's outer frame fixed in the UIListLayout and move only the inner face down by the lip height, so the siblings never re-flow.

defects.defect: The hover shot is pixel-identical to play1 on the HUD Shop tile in every screen. The 1.05 hover is either not applied or too small to see.
defects.fix: Put a UIScale on the button and tween it to 1.08-1.10, brighten the face about 10% and add a 3-5 degree tilt. Check it with a pixel diff.

defects.defect: The open window's bottom edge (y about 975) overlaps the hotbar in E1, E2, E3, E4 and E6. Slot numbers are hidden and the Sword, Pickaxe and Potion icons are cropped.
defects.fix: Hide or slide the hotbar out while a modal is open, or end the window at y 940 or above with at least 20px of air above the hotbar.

defects.defect: All seven eggs (header, Void, Common, Forest, Crystal, Lava, Golden) are the same faceted octagon in pastel tints, which is anti-reference X4 #2/#4 repeated. The Golden Egg is cream rather than gold, the Void Egg is pale lilac rather than dark, and none has a pattern, glow or sparkle.
defects.fix: Give each egg its own art: spots on Common, leaves on Forest, crystal shards on Crystal, flames on Lava, a metallic shine and sparkles on Golden, and dark purple with stars on Void. All of them need saturated colour and a navy outline.

defects.defect: The Forest Egg price button is orange while every other gem price button is green. The colour change follows no rule (100 and 750 are equally affordable).
defects.fix: Use one price-button colour, or a consistent rule such as red or gray for unaffordable, applied to every card.

defects.defect: In the wide price buttons the currency icon is pinned left (gem at x 1125) while the number sits in the centre (x 1300), leaving a 150px gap. The hero 12,500 button (1185 to 1325) has the same problem, and so does the E1 Mega Chest button.
defects.fix: Lay out the icon and number as one horizontally centred group with an 8px gap.

defects.defect: Window titles ('Shop', 'Egg Shop', 'Pets', 'Settings') are about 40px tall in a 140px header that is otherwise about 650px of empty studded colour. P07's title dominates its header; ours reads like a caption.
defects.fix: Set titles at 64-72px with a 4px navy stroke. Let the header icon overlap the window's top-left edge, as in P07.

defects.defect: The coin icon reads as a hex nut or washer (an octagon with a hole), and the gem is a flat pale lavender octahedron. Both are desaturated and are the main currency signals on the HUD and in every card.
defects.fix: Redraw the coin round with a raised rim, an embossed symbol and a specular highlight. Make the gem a saturated faceted cut with highlights. Give both a navy outline.

defects.defect: Key icons are gray: the shopping cart (header and HUD), the gray cat on the Pets tile and the steel chest bands. Gray on saturated tiles reads disabled, and the icons have no navy contour while everything around them has one.
defects.fix: Recolour the cart and the cat (or pick a colourful pet) to saturated colours and add a 4-6px navy outline to every icon render.

defects.defect: Rarity labels (about 18px) sit directly on the button lip ('Legendary' touches the Equipped button at y 570). The rarity colours are also unconventional: Common is teal, Rare purple and Epic pink.
defects.fix: Move rarity to a small coloured pill under the pet name and use the convention players expect: Common gray, Uncommon green, Rare blue, Epic purple, Legendary gold.

defects.defect: The 'Equipped' state is a pale gray button with white text. It has low contrast, reads as disabled, and shows no checkmark or equipped count anywhere in the window.
defects.fix: Add a green check badge on the card corner and an 'Unequip' (red) button, and show 'Equipped 1/3' in the header.

defects.defect: Locked-day buttons repeat the card title ('Day 4' in the header and 'Day 4' on the button, the same for days 5-7), so they carry no information. Claimed days keep full-colour icons with no checkmark.
defects.fix: Show a lock icon plus a countdown on locked buttons. Give claimed cards a large green check overlay and a desaturated icon.

defects.defect: The Day 7 grand prize is badly composed. The chest is jammed against the left border (x about 975), a 300px gray 'Day 7' button is the most dominant element and says nothing, and 'Mega chest' is cased differently from E1's 'Mega Chest'. The 'Today' card (Day 3) is no larger than its neighbours.
defects.fix: Make Day 7 gold with a centred, larger, glowing chest and a 'Grand Prize' label. Scale up and pulse the Today card. Match casing across screens.

defects.defect: The Music and Sound Effects sliders have no knob and no value, so they read as progress bars. A white highlight sliver overshoots the fill end at (1320,418) and (1405,622).
defects.fix: Add a round, navy-outlined knob at the fill end and a percentage label, and clip the top highlight to the fill width.

defects.defect: The Settings icons (music note, speaker, gear) are flat white 2D glyphs, a different family from the 3D renders on every other screen. The same gear appears three times: on the HUD, in the header and on the Graphics row.
defects.fix: Render the note, speaker and a monitor or sparkle icon for Graphics in the same 3D outlined style as the shop icons.

defects.defect: The three settings rows are each about 190px tall and the same blue, with a dead gap of about 200px between label and control. The window is oversized for three controls and reads as filler.
defects.fix: Cut the row height to about 110px and shrink the window. Alternatively, add the expected toggles (Low Detail, Show Pets, Trade Requests) as on/off pill switches.

defects.defect: The XP bar text is about 20px in a 40px bar, 'Level 7' and '640 / 1,000 XP' run together, and the text straddles the fill edge. There is no level badge.
defects.fix: Put the level number in a star or circle badge overlapping the bar's left end and set the XP text at 28px, centred, with a navy stroke.

defects.defect: The currency pill bodies are a light gray gradient that reads disabled, and the pill's right cap shows behind the green '+' button (x about 370), giving a doubled end.
defects.fix: Give the pill a navy or dark tinted body so the yellow and blue numbers pop, and end the pill exactly at the '+' button.

defects.defect: Motion is limited to slow ray rotation and a few px of icon bob over 1.75s. The NEW! badge, the hero price button and the Starter Pack HUD tile (1810,330) are static, so nothing draws the eye to the buy action.
defects.fix: Add a periodic shine sweep across the hero price button, a wobble or pulse on the NEW! badge, and a gentle bounce and glow on the Starter Pack tile.

defects.defect: The Mega Chest icon (also used on E4 Day 7) reads as an arched mailbox or barrel: it has no lid seam or lock and plain orange wood, with no reward feel.
defects.fix: Use a proper treasure chest with a lid seam, gold trim, a lock plate and gold spilling out, with a navy outline.

critics.verdict: Style 6 out of 10. The build has clearly moved past the anti-references. It has navy contours, white window bodies, gradient faces on solid lips, faint studs, real Robux and gem glyphs, and full grids with heroes in the shops, so it no longer looks like X3, X4 or KITpass9. It could not yet sit next to P07-P09, and the reason is mostly the art and the interaction, not the frame. Three changes would raise the score most. (1) Redo the icon set as one saturated, navy-outlined family at roughly 1.5x the current size. Give each egg its own pattern and colour (today all six are one pastel blob), replace the hex-nut coin and pale gem, recolour the gray cart and cat, and render the Settings icons in the same 3D style. (2) Fix the interaction layer. The press must sink only the pressed face onto its lip inside a fixed frame (today it re-flows the whole HUD column and the face rises), the hover must be visible (about 1.08 plus a brighter face), and the hero needs real motion: a shine sweep on the buy button, a pulse on NEW! and Today, and a bounce on Starter Pack. (3) Fix hierarchy and collisions. Set window titles at 64-72px so they own the header, stop windows from overlapping the hotbar, centre icon and number together in price buttons, and make the meaningful state visible: a level badge on the XP bar, checks and locks with timers on Daily Rewards, a standard rarity pill and an equipped badge on Pets, and slider knobs in Settings.

pairwise.why: Right is Pet Simulator 99's Exclusive Shop (Mega Lucky, Huge Hunter, VIP): polished, in-world art and real Robux prices; left is a generic generated shop on a baseplate.
Left looks like a premium UI kit template (Item Name placeholders, checkered panels, cohesive style); right reuses the same generated baseplate HUD as trial 1's left.
The left screen is a live game capture: real Roblox top bar, brainrot spawns, offline-earnings banner and a busy textured shop. The right is a clean mock on a bare baseplate.

The right screen is a live gameplay capture with huge late-game numbers, multiplier stacks and an Admin Abuse event popup over a blurred world. The left is the same baseplate template as the mock in trial 3.
Right shows placeholder 'Item Name'/'Button' labels and a themed space backdrop, typical of a premium UI kit showcase; left sits on a default baseplate with generic pet names, which looks generated.
Right is a Robux shop with layered limited-time egg and bundle offers and 'BUNDLE NAME' placeholders, typical of a premium monetization kit; left is the same baseplate pets panel as trial 5.

Left has the studs-textured, high-saturation simulator style and 'BLABLABLA' placeholder text you'd expect in a sold premium kit; right is a clean, generic layout that looks generated and also appears in trial 7.
Left is a CloudMesh 'Studs-Style UI' kit open in Studio with a full HUD (quests, boosts, hotbar timers); right is the same generic generated HUD as trial 2's right side.
Right is a real live-game capture (dice RNG shop with themed illustrated icons, timers and potion HUD); left is a generic egg shop on an empty baseplate with placeholder egg shapes.
Left has polished, custom-illustrated gamepass cards (clover, cracked egg, collar) with Robux prices, typical of top pet sims; right is the same generic template shop on a bare baseplate.
